proposals.title: Stockholder proposal to set different GHG emissions reductions targets (Scopes 1, 2, and 3)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report within a year, updated annually, on a climate transition plan aligned with well-below 2 degrees Celsius, including short-, medium- and long-term reduction targets for scopes 1, 2, and 3 emissions.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that the stockholders vote " AGAINST " this stockholder proposal

proposals.title: Stockholder proposal to oversee and issue an additional racial equity audit and report
proposals.proponent: Service Employees International Union Master Trust (SEIU)
proposals.topic_summary: Urges the Board to oversee an independent third-party racial equity audit analyzing Valero's impacts on nonwhite stakeholders and communities of color, and plans to mitigate those impacts, with a public report.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal for the reasons explained in the opposition statement below
